en: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....
Turmoil grips the galaxy. In the wake of Alderaan's horrific destruction, the GALACTIC EMPIRE tightens its iron fist across the stars, crushing any world suspected of dissent.

Witnessing the Empire's brutality, the veteran bounty hunter TUK'TAM has abandoned his mercenary neutrality to join the struggling REBEL ALLIANCE. Now trusted with covert operations, he faces his most perilous assignment yet: extracting a high-value defector imprisoned deep within an Imperial stronghold on Akiva.

Time has run out. With an armored prisoner convoy preparing to transfer the defector to an inescapable high-security facility, Tuk races into enemy airspace for a daring infiltration that could decide the fate of the Rebellion....
